intro: Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp wants to know what turned Colonel Kurzen to depravity. Suspecting that troll magic holds him, Nimetz sends you to the troll ruins of Stranglethorn to copy the legends written on four tablets.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Colonel Kurzen was once a great, noble man - I must find what caused his fall into depravity! He may be under the sway of troll magic. To confirm this, I must study some of their legends.
There are 4 tablets hidden within the troll ruins of Stranglethorn. I must see what is written on these tablets! Transcribe their markings and bring the transcriptions back to me.
The first tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins, the second is in the Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend! Do you have the troll legends? I must know their secrets!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. I will study these legends to see if there is some link between the trolls and the evil that has possessed Colonel Kurzen.
